summary: Cadeler A/S filed a Form 6-K furnishing EU Market Abuse Regulation Article 19 notifications of transactions in its own shares by persons discharging managerial responsibilities. CEO Mikkel Gleerup received 104,401 shares underlying vested Restricted Share Units under the 2024 RSU Program on 21 September 2026 at NOK 0, and cash-settled 18,424 RSUs at NOK 58.4192, totaling NOK 1,076,315.34, outside a trading venue. CFO Peter Brogaard Hansen also reported transactions. No board recommendation, advisor, deal terms, or structural mechanics are disclosed; this is routine insider/RSU reporting, not a special situation. No risk-arb angle applies.
